name: Hip Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative whole-joint disease of the hip causing pain, stiffness and functional limitation.

typical: Difficulty with footwear, stairs and walking

investigations.principle: Use imaging when clinical diagnosis is uncertain or treatment planning requires it.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI for suspected AVN, occult fracture or alternative pathology.
investigations.radiographs: AP pelvis/hip radiographs assess joint-space narrowing and structural OA.

amber: Medication, injection and total hip arthroplasty decisions require individualized risk/benefit assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhigata Vata phenotype correlation may be documented; modern hip OA diagnosis remains visible in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative whole-joint disease of the hip causing pain, stiffness and functional limitation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.
